prerequisites: ELASTICIDAD Y RESISTENCIA DE MATERIALES I/20224106
ELASTICIDAD Y RESISTENCIA DE MATERIALES II/20224107

learning_outcomes.text: Calculates and designs structures and industrial constructions.
Knows and selects materials for construction elements.
Ability to design structures according to standardized criteria.
Uses structural calculation and finite element programs.
Knows and applies structural calculation methods.

syllabus_topics: Materials for structure construction: characteristic features and uses
Calculation of steel structures: basic normative aspects
ULS at section level for steel structures
ULS of elastic instability for steel structures
Calculation of reinforced concrete structures: basic normative aspects
ULS at section level for reinforced concrete structures
Other ULS for reinforced concrete structures
teaching_methods: Introductory activities (video and PowerPoint presentations of works, building projects, etc.)
Lecture (theoretical presentation and explanation of the course program)
Problem/exercise solving in the classroom (delivery, formulation, resolution, and discussion of problems and exercises)
Preliminary project (team work, presentation of a preliminary building structure project)

assessment_methods.method: Problem solving and exercises in class

assessment_rules: To pass in the first attempt, a total score of 5.00 or higher is required, along with a minimum of 3.00 in both the arithmetic mean of the first partial exam and short answer test, and the second partial exam. If the average of the first partial and short answer test is below 3.00, the student proceeds directly to the second attempt, which is a final exam worth 100%. For the second attempt, a single final exam is given, also worth 100%, requiring a minimum score of 5.00 to pass. Unauthorized electronic devices must be switched off and out of sight during exams.
